correctness.rationale: The exact first-event recursion over susceptible S, currently infected I and historical peak h has terminal (n-|S|,h). Each infection reduces |S| and each recovery reduces |I| at fixed |S|; induction terminates. The 11 connected types through order4 give 43 root-pair comparisons, 18 unequal; source checker sympy computes exact rational difference products with nonnegative polynomial numerator and denominator for all β>0 and checks ties. Independent standard-library Fraction recurrence on five-vertex E={01,13,14,23,24,34} at β=2 visited 378 states and reproduced F1=2617/675, H1=5176097/1559250, F3=3679/945, H3=16018271/4851000, final maximizers {3,4}, peak maximizer {1}. Small-order assertion rests on exact algebraic finite certificate over parameter continuum, not β-grid sampling.

value.rationale: Expected cumulative infection reach and realized maximum concurrent infectious occupancy are genuinely different mathematically and epidemiologically motivated objectives. A sharp smallest graph where seed rankings differ is a natural structural cutoff and informs limits of substituting final-size centrality for peak-burden centrality; no empirical clinical forecasting is implied.

final_claim: For homogeneous Markovian continuous-time SIR on any connected graph of at most four vertices, the single-seed rankings by expected final infections and expected maximum simultaneously infectious agree at every infection-rate β>0; a specific diamond-plus-leaf graph with five vertices has different maximizers at β=2.
limitations: For all connected graphs n≤4 and every β>0; five-vertex only explicit β=2 witness, no classification n>4.
Not an assertion about maximum of expected prevalence, incidence peak or tail-probability-optimal roots.
